text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, when we went to the 
academy's uninhabited island to scout it 
for training—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The ferry back isn't running?! What the 
hell?!

text_block_list.name: Crewman
text_block_list.text:
It is most likely an error in the main 
system that handles the ship's 
autopilot...

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text:
The other boats are either fully booked or 
in for repairs... It looks like they won't 
be able to pick us up until midnight.
choice_data_list: So it takes quite some time...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Let me see that for a second.

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, look at this—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Main system's fine. The battery just died, 
so the ship's control system went down 
with it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so basically that, right? Like a 
chupacabra tossed out into Antarctica?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My octopus pot fortune said "Catching 
squid brings good luck," so I hopped right 
onto a boat setting sail!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
After all the trouble I went through to 
catch 'em, too! Midnight, you say?! If 
they lose their freshness, the squid and 
the urchins'll both be cryin'!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Shakur, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All that matters is getting it charged. As 
long as we find a way to generate power—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The moment their eyes met, the two darted 
off... Without a clue what was going on, I 
hurriedly chased after them!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!! Coconuts acquired!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"No, that is fine as it is. Palm is 
gaining attention as a material for 
biomass power generation, after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Her behavioral patterns are ridiculously 
set in stone, but... in an emergency like 
this, that might actually be our 
breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, Golshi's all about 
how ya use 'er!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... Golshi is boooored...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This damn RNG bastard... But, I saw that 
coming.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Hand over that stuff you 
picked up on the beach earlier!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, what the heck?! Nobody 
told me there'd be a bicycle from the 
order Bicyclia, family Pseudo-Unicyclidae 
around here!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Since it doesn't have handlebars, you ride 
it with your arms spread wide... A totally 
insane ride that pulls off a style 
normally reserved for unicycles!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, get over here! Let's pedal 
while picturing the French mountain passes 
in our minds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, skillfully managing the 
unpredictable Gold Ship, Air Shakur 
steadily prepared to recharge her 
batteries—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*whiiiiiir*)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The palm stuff came together surprisingly 
well. Just gathered scraps and winged it, 
but... not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Crewman
text_block_list.text: Ah, just a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroom! Beep beep beep...)

text_block_list.name: Crewman
text_block_list.text:
I-It's on! The reception is coming through 
loud and clear!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head home quick. I'm sick 
and tired of looking at the ocean anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to their coordinated, all-out 
effort, we managed to return to the 
academy safely...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You bet! A piece of cake for the great 
Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, feeling good, aren't ya... Think 
about what it's like for me having to 
match your moves, damn it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What was that!? Things only worked out 
'cause I went all out with super-momentum, 
didn't they!?
choice_data_list:
You two get along pretty well after all, 
huh?

You two get along pretty well after all, 
huh?

Anyway, I'm just glad you made it back 
safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What was that!? Things only worked out 
'cause I went all out with super-momentum, 
didn't they!?
choice_data_list:
You two get along pretty well after all, 
huh?

You two get along pretty well after all, 
huh?

Anyway, I'm just glad you made it back 
safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Did that gibberish of theirs rub off on 
you too? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha... *sniffle*... How cruel... And 
here I thought Golshi-chan and Shaka-chan 
were best buddies, the kind even Venusians 
would envy...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Annoying...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As fellow natural talents, they seemed to 
share a connection... It was a moment that 
revealed an unexpected side of them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Lost a ton of time. Better organize 
this data quickly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Shakur! Let's split today's loot, 
alright!? I'll bring it over right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A fir tree remodeled into a kadomatsu just 
so it can survive past Christmas!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur looked troubled, but all in 
all, it ended up being a memorable 
experience!
